rule: BTC daily close above its daily MA100 = risk-on, below = risk-off (HANDOFF §5f). Books: each leg sized to 30%/yr from BTC's trailing 60-day realised volatility, max 2x; the position decided at the 00:00 UTC close is held through the next day; 0.08% per side on exposure changes; perp funding charged (estimated from the last 30 known days where the archive has not published the month yet).
